# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_MORNING_TRIGGER

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Entering on bearish rejection morning setups (ribbon-flip-at-level bear entry within 09:35-10:55 ET at named levels) captures the majority of J's winner days (4/29 and 5/04) while avoiding loser days, because the structure is specific to strong bearish rejection moves that characterize the J winners. This trigger aims to increase edge_capture by improving winner conversion and reducing loser exposure on J anchor days.

## Mechanism

Trigger fires when all conditions are met: (1) time between 09:35 and 10:55 ET, (2) ribbon=BEAR (fast EMA < pivot EMA < slow EMA on 3‑min chart), (3) price rejects a named level (premarket high, prior day high, or multi‑day descending trendline) with a close back below the level after touching, (4) no volume divergence on the breakdown bar (volume on breakdown bar ≤ 1.2× average of prior 2 bars). Entry = next bar open at ITM‑2 put strike (0DTE). Exit logic: chart stop (close above rejected level + $0.50 buffer) is primary; chandelier profit‑lock arms at +5% favor and trails 0.15 off the high‑water mark; TP1 sells 2/3 of quantity at +50% premium; runner exits on re‑entry into the EMA ribbon or when premium reaches ×3.0 of entry.
